title: Config flow step
description:
One screen of a setup wizard, returned by `configFlow` (spec §7.4, plugin-ui-integration.md §4).

The plugin drives the flow and the core renders it: the core holds the session state between steps, renders whatever the current step describes, and passes the user's input back on the next call. A plugin never draws anything — that is the whole point of the layer.

Discriminated on `type`. Nine kinds; every one carries `title` and may carry `next`.

base.description: Fields every step kind carries, regardless of type.

next.title: Next step id
next.description: What the core should pass as `step` when the user advances. Absent on terminal steps (`complete`, and `error` without a retry).

sessionId.title: Config flow session id
sessionId.description: Identifies this wizard run. Appears in `commissioning.<sessionId>.progress` push topics so a `progress` step can be animated live.

step.description: A complete step: the common fields plus exactly one type-specific branch.

oneOf.title: form
oneOf.description: Renders a JSON Schema as a form — the same renderer as a plugin's flat config screen.

uiHints.title: Per-field rendering hints
uiHints.description: Widget overrides keyed by field name — `password`, `textarea`, `select`. Advisory: a renderer that does not know a hint falls back to the type.

oneOf.title: oauth
oneOf.description: Core opens the provider in a new window and catches the callback.

callbackPath.title: Path the core should listen on

oneOf.title: qr-scan
oneOf.description: Core opens its QR scanner and returns the decoded string.

allowManualEntry.description: Whether the user may type the payload instead. True for Matter setup codes, which are printed as digits as well as a QR.

oneOf.title: progress
oneOf.description: Progress bar driven by `commissioning.<sessionId>.progress` pushes. The core advances to `next` when the plugin reports completion.

oneOf.title: pick-device
oneOf.description: Multi-select over devices the plugin has found — pairing several at once.

oneOf.title: manual-action
oneOf.description: Instruction plus a done button — "press the button on the device, then confirm".

oneOf.title: error
oneOf.description: Terminal unless `retryStep` is set, in which case the core offers to go back to it.

deviceRefs.title: Devices this flow produced
deviceRefs.description: Lets the core jump straight to what was just added.
